about:
Workers LLC, based in Neenah, Wisconsin, was founded to serve the meat processing industry with a focus on reliability, expertise, and personal service. The company operates from a facility on Smith Street and has built a reputation as a local source for equipment, parts, and support.

The company distributes food processing and packaging equipment from brands such as Hollymatic, Sipromac, Talsa, Risco, Rice Lake, Bizerba, and TSC, along with vacuum pouches, roll-stock films, and a range of butcher supplies. In addition to sales, Workers LLC provides equipment service and repair, installation and setup, and stocks replacement parts to keep production lines running.

Its customers include meat processors, food production plants, and butcher shops throughout the region. Concrete examples include supplying Hollymatic patty machines for portioning, Sipromac vacuum sealers for packaging, and Bizerba slicers and scales for weighing and labeling.

The business emphasizes responsive local service to minimize equipment downtime, a differentiator highlighted in its own messaging about reducing stress and keeping production moving without interruption.
